title: anim.stickpre/1
description: data/anim/stick_pre.json: the right stick's strike drawn before the request starts (docs/animation/stick-pre.md; AnimFighter's pre layer): Controls' hub.strike_pre(slot) publishes the direction while the stick leans in; the layer eases that direction's quick piece's chamber in at w over enter_ticks, lets go over exit_ticks, and lets a pre-read with no request go after stale_ticks. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

w.description: How much of the pose is mixed in at full depth, 0 to 1.

enter_ticks.description: Ticks the pose takes to ease in.

exit_ticks.description: Ticks the pose takes to let go.

stale_ticks.description: Ticks after which a pre-read with no request is let go.

up.description: A chamber pose id of the stick class (pz. or rz.): the direction's quick piece's chamber.

down.description: A chamber pose id of the stick class (pz. or rz.): the direction's quick piece's chamber.

toward.description: A chamber pose id of the stick class (pz. or rz.): the direction's quick piece's chamber.

away.description: A chamber pose id of the stick class (pz. or rz.): the direction's quick piece's chamber.

additionalProperties.description: One fighter's chamber for each direction (toward and away by his facing).

dirs.description: Fighter id to the poses for up, down, toward and away.
